_comment: Admin console beats for Part 2: one per narrated metric. Each beat's footage is the recording while that metric was held (spotlight removed by unspot.py); the edit draws its own highlight while the line plays. 'pre' adds the clean lead-in (clip seconds) before the first metric; 'extra' moves the highlight to a second metric on the same screen when the line reaches 'phrase'.
